commands.command: node --input-type=module -e 'import {DatabaseSync} from "node:sqlite"; import {readFileSync,readdirSync} from "node:fs"; const db=new DatabaseSync(":memory:"); db.exec("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON"); const dir="crates/jobsentinel-storage/migrations/"; const migrations=readdirSync(dir).filter(name=>name.endsWith(".sql")).sort(); const last=migrations.pop(); for(const name of migrations) db.exec(readFileSync(dir+name,"utf8")); const rows=()=>db.prepare("SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type IN (?, ?)").all("trigger","index").filter(row=>row.sql!==null); const before=rows(); db.exec("BEGIN"); db.exec(readFileSync(dir+last,"utf8")); db.exec("COMMIT"); const after=new Map(rows().map(row=>[row.name,row.sql])); const normalize=sql=>sql.replace(/\s+/g,"").replaceAll("\"",""); const changed=before.filter(row=>!after.has(row.name)||normalize(after.get(row.name))!==normalize(row.sql)); console.log(JSON.stringify({migration:last,priorObjects:before.length,changed:changed.map(row=>row.name),foreignKeys:db.prepare("PRAGMA foreign_key_check").all()},null,2)); for(const row of changed) console.log(JSON.stringify({name:row.name,before:row.sql,after:after.get(row.name)}));'
commands.result: All 182 prior trigger/index definitions preserved after whitespace/SQLite identifier-quoting normalization; foreign-key check empty

red_evidence: Packaging tests failed on absent runtime configuration and missing upgrade commands before implementation.

Original domain test-first execution was not observed; an isolated Region-guard mutation failed the acceptance test and restoration passed. It is mutation proof, not a claim of historical test-first execution.
The initial migration failed because surviving triggers referenced tables during rebuild; all dependent triggers were preserved around the rebuild and exact normalized schema comparison passed.
First-run Doctor regression tests failed for paused safety states, malformed schemas, empty/duplicate permission areas, duplicate privacy IDs and contradictory model status before corrections.

Installed smoke initially entered platform recovery because /var is a symlink; canonical temporary-root creation plus matching child TMPDIR fixed the verifier without weakening application symlink guards.
review: Independent regional adversarial review returned SOUND. Packaging review identified model.bin scanning and retired same-version artifact cleanup gaps; both were corrected with red/green tests. Final smoke diagnosis preserved existing security guards.
caveats: This record is partial Milestone 9 evidence, not milestone, v3.0 release, or full v3 completion.
Production region publisher trust remains unchanged and no regional pack was signed or published.
No full test suite, new model transfer, enforced 8 GiB run, exact macOS 26 run, Windows 11 run or Linux package run was performed in this slice.
Ad-hoc signatures do not establish public Gatekeeper acceptance; Developer ID signing and notarization remain release requirements.
The full milestone gate and remaining regional, veteran/access, edition and distribution acceptance requirements remain open.
